Customer Support Phone Specialist | USA Only

We're looking for someone who knows how to talk to people, not just read a script.

What the day may look like
- Take inbound customer calls
- Make outbound follow-up calls when needed
- Schedule, confirm, or reschedule appointments
- Follow simple scripts and company guidelines
- Record important details from conversations
- Handle common customer questions
- Escalate issues when they need additional support

You should be able to:
- Speak clear, natural English
- Listen before responding
- Stay calm with difficult customers
- Follow instructions without sounding robotic
- Show up reliably and communicate professionally

Customer service experience is helpful, but it is not required.
